headword: {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}

definitions.gloss: due date; expected date of delivery
definitions.explanation: The date on which a baby is expected to be born, as calculated by a doctor. The standard term on maternity forms and in conversation about a pregnancy.

examples.japanese: {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: The baby was born a week before the due date.

examples.japanese: {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{六週間前|ろくしゅうかんまえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{産休|さんきゅう}→産休：06997_sankyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can start maternity leave from six weeks before the due date.

notes:
Frequently shortened to {予定日|よていび} once the context is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: the due date approaches
- {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass the due date
- {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: earlier than the due date

CULTURAL NOTE:
The due date matters administratively as well as medically: Japanese maternity leave (⟦{産休|さんきゅう}→産休：06997_sankyuu⟧) is calculated from it, normally six weeks before and eight weeks after the birth.
